scope: Baseline public-data diagnostics; not a discovery analysis

nets3.caveat: The in-sample weighted linear regression is diagnostic. A reduction in WRMS is expected from fitting an additional covariate and is not evidence that the correction is astrophysically valid.
nets3.run_sensitivity_caveat: Between-run weighted-mean differences contain both instrumental and astrophysical long-timescale structure. Per-run de-meaning is a sensitivity diagnostic and can absorb real companions.

nets4_hd190360.interpretation: This intentionally simplified NEID-only circular-plus-linear-trend check is not the published multi-planet/multi-instrument solution. The discrepancy is treated as a model-adequacy warning, not a revised planet amplitude.

atmospheric_metadata.caveat: Multiple spectrum records are candidates for reproducibility analysis; some can be alternate reductions of the same photons and are not automatically statistically independent.
